notes: Camera: the setup's calibrated ego camera (register_table_camera source=setup) at 640x480; the grid lies on the cloth. The video's first second has a green colour cast; the rack colour is measured (measure_object_color), tip box and pipette keep their constructors' colours.
SAM 3 returned nothing for 'clear plastic tube' and 'grey pipette'; the masks used 'small cup' (split left/right into the tube (well 1) and the rack tube (well 2)) and 'pipette' at min_score 0.05.

Re-staged for the current Stage 1 ids (tube_rack, tube, rack_tube, pipette, tip_box, tip) with attach prefixes that keep every id resolving to its own bodies and no id's '<id>_' prefix capturing another object (held tube 'held_tube', rack 'tube_rack_rack', rack tube 'rack_tube_srctube', tip box 'tip_box_tipbox' with its free tip 'tip_box_tipbox_tip'); every object keeps the fitted frame-0 placement of the earlier verified scene.

Tip box rebuilt with construct_tip_box_lowpoly (created): the original construct_tip_box gave the lid a hand-written 1e-7 kg m^2 inertia (38x too small for its plates), drew 95 standing tips as visual stubs 15.6 mm proud of any collision geometry and put 148 collision geoms within 6 cm of the free tip (one box per tray cell, 37 per tip); the fork merges the tray into slabs under the drawn collars, cages the free tip's collar in a slab hole, infers the lid inertia from its plates (25 g, stiff hinge friction so it holds its own weight) and uses a 12-capsule snap lip (47 collision geoms near the tip). Its test presses a micropipette onto the free tip with a force grip: it snaps on and rides a 7 cm lift.

Rack rebuilt with construct_conical_tube_rack_catch_holes (created): in the plain rack the leaning pipette's nose stood on the flat bottom plate, held sideways by friction only; MuJoCo's soft friction crept and the pipette slid and fell within 3 s (9 s with the executor's no-slip iterations) - the earlier scene only passed the 1 s keyframe check. A 17 mm catch hole under the end well holds the nose by its edges: the pipette now stands at a 14 deg lean (closer to the video's ~19 deg than the earlier 11 deg; IoU 0.50 vs 0.46) and moves 0.06 mm in 4 s.

Render traps fixed in scene.xml: <quality offsamples=0> (MSAA blends segmentation ids at thin geoms); translucent colours are opaque (clear plastic is a Stage 4 retexture job); rack hole rim discs are 0.2 mm visual-only disks.

tip: the exact tip-box hole is not resolvable at this resolution; the free tip stands in well (row 0, col 11) and its mask is that well's rendered collar inside the video's tip-box mask, so its IoU proves only that the well lies on the visible tray.
Tube lift-out and drop-back have no library verifier; covered by the well geometry (25.6 mm wells for 24 mm rims) and contact_check.

REACH: object_reach_check reports the free tip (y = 0.39 m) 30 mm short of the right arm's palm-down band; the tip box is where the video has it, so Stage 3 has to reach it with an orientation the arm holds or move the stations.

Rack friction is the constructor's default 0.8: the earlier scene had raised it to 1.2 so the leaning pipette would not slide off the flat bottom plate; with the catch hole holding the nose that is no longer needed, and at 1.2 the barrel's friction on the hole edge lifted the light rack out with the pipette (measured in Stage 3: rack thrown 14 cm at 1.2, untouched at 0.8).
